decisions.by: stage 0-1 agent default; the user may override
decisions.decision: The spectral ghost arm is his LEFT arm (image right in the approved front), exactly as the concept paints it; the glowing eye and the face glow are on the same side. The concept is fed to TRELLIS.2 as painted, NOT mirrored.
decisions.why: The workflow's task text says 'his RIGHT arm' and 'the right side of the face'; both describe the picture as seen (image right). The approved front is the design authority and is internally consistent: his right hand (black fingerless glove, the long holster on his right thigh) is the gun hand, the ghost hand the off hand. serpent_smg is one-handed and rides weapon_R; the Bullet Ballet twin pistol is a VFX copy on weapon_L.
decisions.consequence: Stage 2 paints the ghost-arm emissive zone on the body's LEFT forearm and hand (+X in Blender, the hero facing -Y). If the user wants the ghost arm on his right, stage 1 is re-run on a horizontally mirrored input (one PIL ImageOps.mirror), which also moves the holster, the face glow, the hair streak and the scar.

decisions.by: stage 0-1 agent (weapons decision of 2026-09-25: weapons are separate models; the task's instruction to remove the weapons from the image when they would fuse into the hands)
decisions.decision: The TRELLIS.2 input is the verbatim approved front with an edited alpha: the two serpent revolvers and the diffuse translucent ghost smoke are cut out of the birefnet mask (the fists and the coat's ragged hem stay). No pixel is repainted.
decisions.why: The barrels are collinear with the arms and the grips sit inside the fists, so TRELLIS.2 would grow one arm-gun tube per arm; the smoke (with the navy background showing through its holes) is in birefnet's mask and would become wide opaque fins round the coat.
decisions.consequence: references/kael_concept_front_nogun.png (+ _mask.png), made by tools/blender/gf_hero/kael_stage1_input.py, fed with run_trellis.py --own-mask. Record: reports/blockout/input_edit.png.

1_blockout.notes: Done 2026-09-27. SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY - never shipped, never copied to assets/models/, never rigged. TRELLIS.2 (Pixal3D pruned) at the user's character settings (700k faces, 4096 px), 3 seeds (101/202/303). Input: the approved front with the two revolvers and the diffuse ghost smoke cut out of birefnet's mask (decisions[stage1_input_cut]); birefnet itself kept the whole dark-on-dark figure (reports/blockout/input_maskcheck.png). s202 picked: the only seed with both hands right (gloved right fist with skin fingers, ghost left fist; s101 swaps the hand textures, s303 gloves the ghost hand and keeps a grip tunnel through the right fist), a solid violet-navy coat back torn into long points and clear of the legs, one main shell and the fewest non-manifold edges. Its face glow is baked as a pale patch: use the concept and s303's head for the face. Known defects (thick fused coat flaring wider than the concept, no emissive or ghost-flame tatters - authored in stage 2 -, soft face, baked lighting) in reports/blockout_report.md section 6. Review renders: Cycles CPU + Workbench (kael copies of the shared renderers; never EEVEE).
